headline: Ethereum Developers Fix Flaw Linked to Security Issue at Indian Certificate Firm
summary: A security blunder at Indian certificate issuer eMudhra left some Ethereum Teku and Besu setups trusting forged certificates. Developers issued fixes, and default mainnet nodes were not exposed.
why: Ethereum is a prominent public blockchain platform supporting digital assets and smart contracts. Maintaining security across node clients is essential for network stability.
